fixes.problem: The level label is left in English and was not translated into Indonesian.
'foto identitas resmi apa pun' means 'any official ID photo' (a picture), not 'any official photo ID' (an identity document that has a photo).
fixes.fix: kartu identitas (tanda pengenal resmi berfoto apa pun)

fixes.problem: 'Thank you' was mistranslated as 'De nada', which means 'You're welcome'. This changes the meaning of the line.
fixes.fix: Obrigado. O que a traz aqui hoje?

fixes.problem: '발' means foot, but 'chân' on its own can mean the whole leg (다리) or the foot. For a vocabulary item this is misleading; 'bàn chân' is the precise word.
fixes.fix: Thêm bộ phận cơ thể và trợ từ đúng (이 hoặc 가). Bàn chân (발) tôi bị đau: ____ 아파서 왔어요. / Tai (귀) tôi bị đau: ____ 아파서 왔어요.

fixes.problem: '高级' means 'advanced', so '初级(高级)' reads as 'beginner (advanced)', which contradicts itself. The English means the upper part of the beginner level.
The final period in the Korean quote was changed from '.' to the Chinese full stop '。'. The Korean must stay exactly as in the English line.
fixes.fix: 接待人员说'이름 부르면 들어가세요.'你应该怎么做?(a) 立刻进去。(b) 先等着,叫到名字时再进去。(c) 写下名字然后回家。

fixes.problem: Wrong verb for the ID: you can't 'nennen' (state) an ID card. English 'give' here means hand over or show it.
fixes.fix: In einer Klinik anmelden: sag '처음 왔어요', nenne deinen Namen und dein Geburtsdatum, zeig deinen Ausweis, sag mit '-이/가 아파서 왔어요', warum du gekommen bist, und verstehe '이름 부르면 들어가세요'.

fixes.problem: Wrong gender for the grammar term: 'die Partikel' is feminine; 'das Partikel' is the physics word. The accusative must be 'die richtige Partikel'.
fixes.fix: Füge den Körperteil und die richtige Partikel (이 oder 가) hinzu. Mein Fuß (발) tut weh: ____ 아파서 왔어요. / Mein Ohr (귀) tut weh: ____ 아파서 왔어요.
